annotation.interpretation_a: The request must be sent directly to the origin server, i.e., without any intermediaries (proxies, gateways, etc.) in the path.
annotation.interpretation_b: The request must be addressed to the origin server, but may still pass through intermediaries; the word 'directly' refers only to the target, not the transmission path.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether 'directly' means the request must bypass intermediaries or merely be addressed to the origin server, allowing two materially different implementation behaviours.
